# Does your AI coding agent's instruction file still match your repo?

> Paste AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md and find referenced file paths that no longer exist, undefined npm scripts and shell footguns. Free, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [Why AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files rot](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/agent-instructions-drift-check/why-ai-agent-instruction-files-rot.html)
